sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: An elf who was once exiled for committing a grievous crime. Born a half-demon, he had the ability to wilt the flora around him since birth. For this reason he was despised even by his own family, and only found acceptance in the late queen of the elves, who took him in when he was young. One day, when Griev believed the queen to be in mortal danger at the hands of a beast, he spontaneously released his deadly miasma and decimated his surroundings in the process. This resulted in his exile, from which he could not return for more than a decade.
